task.maidpatina.rust_removal.desc: Finds nearby oxidized copper and removes one oxidation stage.
task.maidpatina.waxing.desc: Finds nearby waxable blocks and applies wax.
task.maidpatina.advanced_honey.desc: Helps a bee gather nectar from a flower in the head-display slot or either hand, then deposit it at a hive in another position.
task.maidpatina.advanced_honey.condition: Requires a beehive or bee nest in the head-display slot or either hand
Requires a bee-accepted flower in the head-display slot or either hand
